patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: Twenty years of job-site burritos never bothered me — this ain't that. Came on sudden, like a truck. Hurts to move, so I'm not movin'.
clinical.presentationShort: 52yo M — sudden severe epigastric pain, won't move, daily NSAIDs.
clinical.presentationLong: 52-year-old male, sudden severe epigastric pain, now refusing to move, takes NSAIDs daily for his back.

diagnosis.primary: Perforated peptic ulcer with peritonitis (chronic NSAID use) — surgical emergency; also exclude cardiac
diagnosis.disposition: Acute → NPO, large-bore IV + fluids, upright CXR / CT for free air, IV PPI + broad-spectrum antibiotics, analgesia, urgent surgical consult; ECG to rule out ACS
diagnosis.why: 🎯 Tough guy who won't move + sudden 'indigestion' + fever = perforation till proven otherwise. Peritonitis lies STILL; colic writhes. And always ECG the epigastric pain.
diagnosis.redFlag: Sudden severe epigastric pain + rigid & still + fever = surgical abdomen, not heartburn. Movement-averse = peritonitis

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: bald man about 50, stocky and slightly overweight, in dusty construction clothes — work shirt and hi-vis vest
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting bolt upright and very still, rigid, one hand hovering just above his upper abdomen without pressing, reluctant to move
aiImageGeneration.expression: NOT a grimace — quiet dread and fear: wide, worried eyes, brows raised, jaw set, mouth closed; a sheen of sweat on his brow and scalp; a tough man unsettled because something is clearly wrong
signs: holding very still, braced and rigid
hand hovering protectively over the upper belly, not pressing
diaphoretic — sweat on brow and bald scalp
frightened, wary eyes rather than an active wince
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: a tough guy who's clearly scared — stays rigid, afraid to move
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a bald Black man about 50, stocky and slightly overweight, in dusty construction clothes (work shirt and hi-vis vest), seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting bolt upright and very still, rigid, one hand hovering just above his upper abdomen without pressing. Expression: quiet dread and fear - wide worried eyes, raised brows, jaw set, mouth closed (NOT a grimace, NOT gritted teeth). Clearly visible: braced rigid stillness, hand hovering over the upper belly, sweat on brow and bald scalp. Overall a tough guy who is clearly scared and afraid to move. No text, no logos.
